title: Thirty-second vertical video script under twelve production constraints

requirements.text: script.json has title, duration 30.0 and 8 to 12 beats with the required fields
Beats start at 0.0, end at 30.0, are contiguous, and each lasts 1.5 to 4.0 seconds with at most one decimal
The first caption is a question of at most 6 words
Every caption has at most 32 characters and 6 words, on one line
Captions are all different except that the last repeats the first exactly
The title has at most 60 characters and contains Lantern Tide
Voiceover: at most 12 words per beat, 75 in total, empty in at most two beats
None of the banned words appears anywhere
The word wishlist appears in exactly one caption, in a beat starting at 22.0 or later
captions.srt is valid and matches the beats one to one
The release day Friday and the three platforms are each mentioned
No files other than script.json and captions.srt are created
